OurPlatform.title: One Ecosystem
OurPlatform.description: AgroTrust brings together the key participants in global commodity trade into one structured ecosystem. Through a controlled framework, buyers, producers, capital partners, and service providers can operate with more transparency, security, and efficiency across every stage of the transaction.

1.title: Buyer due diligence & structuring
1.description: AgroTrust begins by validating parties involved and defining the structure of the transaction. This includes assessing counterparties, aligning deal terms, and creating a framework that reduces uncertainty before execution begins.

2.title: Collateral & financing
2.description: Once the deal is structured, the platform supports the financial layer of the transaction through collateral organization and funding coordination. This helps ensure that capital is deployed within a secure framework that protects all parties involved.

3.title: Shipment & escrow
3.description: AgroTrust helps coordinate the operational and financial controls tied to execution, including shipment oversight and escrow mechanisms. This adds a layer of protection and transparency as goods and payments move through the process.

4.title: Distribution & final execution
4.description: The final stage focuses on completing the transaction efficiently and ensuring all participants remain aligned through delivery and distribution. The result is a more seamless execution process with clearer accountability from start to finish.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: AgroTrust, LLC ("AgroTrust," "we," "us"), operates a structured trade finance platform connecting investors, producers, buyers and service providers in agricultural commodity trade. This policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your choices.

information.title: 1. Information we collect
items: Contact details you give us: name, company, email address, phone or WhatsApp number, and the content of your inquiry.
Business and transaction information needed to evaluate or operate a trade, including know-your-customer (KYC) and anti-money-laundering (AML) documentation.
Technical data collected automatically when you visit our website, such as IP address, browser type and pages viewed.

use.title: 2. How we use information
items: To respond to inquiries and provide our services.
To evaluate, document, execute and settle transactions on our platform.
To send service messages by email, phone or text message (SMS), including reminders, confirmations and follow-ups, where you have agreed to receive them.
To meet legal, regulatory, compliance and security obligations.

sms.title: 3. Text messaging (SMS) and mobile information
items: If you agree to receive text messages from AgroTrust, we use your mobile number only to send you the messages you agreed to. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out at any time, or HELP for help. See our SMS Terms.

No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. All the categories of sharing described in this policy exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.

sharing.title: 4. How we share information
sharing.intro: We do not sell personal information. We share it only:
items: With service providers who help us operate the platform (for example escrow agents, logistics providers, hosting and messaging providers), under confidentiality obligations and only as needed to provide the service.
With counterparties to a transaction you take part in, to the extent required to execute it.
When required by law, regulation, court order, or to protect our rights and the security of the platform.

retention.title: 5. Data retention and security
retention.content: We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes above or as required by law, and we protect it with administrative, technical and physical safeguards appropriate to its sensitivity.

choices.title: 6. Your choices and rights
choices.content: You may ask to access, correct or delete your personal information, or withdraw consent to messages, by contacting us below. You can opt out of text messages at any time by replying STOP.

changes.title: 7. Changes
changes.content: We may update this policy. The "Last updated" date shows the latest version.

contact.title: 8. Contact
contact.content: AgroTrust, LLC · 8 The Green, Suite D, Dover, DE 19901, USA · admin@agrotrust.com.ve · +1 954 353 6494 (TEXT & WHATSAPP)

program.title: 1. Program description.
program.content: The AgroTrust messaging program sends service text messages to clients, partners, lenders, producers and service providers who have agreed to receive them. Messages include meeting and deadline reminders, document and signature requests, transaction status updates, and follow-ups. Every message begins: "This text is being sent by AgroTrust's Agent." We do not send marketing messages through this program.

optIn.title: 2. How you opt in.
optIn.content: You agree to receive messages by checking the SMS consent box on our website contact form, or by giving your consent in writing (for example by email) or verbally to an AgroTrust representative, who records it. Consent is not a condition of any purchase or service.

frequency.title: 3. Message frequency.
frequency.content: Message frequency varies based on your activity with AgroTrust.

costs.title: 4. Costs.
costs.content: Message and data rates may apply, according to your mobile plan.

optingOut.title: 5. Opting out.
optingOut.content: Reply STOP to any message to stop receiving texts. You will receive one final message confirming you have been unsubscribed. To rejoin, reply START or contact us.

help.title: 6. Help.
help.content: Reply HELP to any message, or contact us at admin@agrotrust.com.ve or +1 954 353 6494 (TEXT & WHATSAPP)

carriers.title: 7. Carriers.
carriers.content: Mobile carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

privacy.title: 8. Privacy.
privacy.content: Your mobile number and consent are handled under our Privacy Policy. No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.

agreement.title: 1.1 Agreement.
agreement.content: These Terms of Service (the "Terms") govern access to and use of the website at agrotrust.com.ve, the AgroTrust platform, and any related documents, tools and communications (together, the "Platform"), operated by AgroTrust, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("AgroTrust", "we", "us"). By accessing or using the Platform, submitting an inquiry, or signing any agreement that references these Terms, you ("you" or the "User") agree to these Terms. If you act for a company, you confirm you are authorized to bind it.

relationship.title: 1.2 Relationship to Transaction Documents.
relationship.content: Each transaction is governed by separate written agreements signed by the parties to it, which may include a platform agreement with AgroTrust, a loan and security agreement, an escrow agreement, a warehousing and collateral management agreement, and carrier, destination agent and customs broker acknowledgments (the "Transaction Documents"). If these Terms conflict with a signed Transaction Document, the Transaction Document prevails for that transaction. AgroTrust is not a party to any loan agreement, escrow agreement, sale contract or carriage contract between other participants unless it signs it.

eligibility.title: 1.3 Eligibility.
eligibility.content: The Platform is intended only for businesses and professional or institutional participants acting in a commercial capacity. It is not offered to consumers or to the general public. You may not use the Platform if you, your owners or your controllers are the subject of sanctions, or if your use would breach any law that applies to you.

definitions.title: 1.4 Definitions.
definitions.content: Capitalized terms have the meanings below. Where a Transaction Document defines a term differently, that definition applies to that transaction.

termsList.definition: any person or entity that uses the Platform or takes part in a Transaction, including Exporters, Financing Entities, Offtakers and Service Providers.
the entity exporting commodities that may receive financing from a Financing Entity.
an independent financial institution, fund or entity that decides on its own whether to provide financing to an Exporter under a Loan Agreement.
the buyer of the Inventory, obligated to pay for it.

any independent third party providing services in a Transaction, including escrow banks, collateral management warehouses, carriers, NVOCCs, freight forwarders, shipping and logistics agents, destination agents, customs brokers, insurers, foreign exchange providers, and payment and digital asset service providers.
the commodities that are the subject of a Transaction and serve as collateral.
the account held by an independent Escrow Bank to receive and distribute Transaction funds under an Escrow Agreement.
the document issued by a Warehouse Operator evidencing custody of Inventory and a security interest in favor of the Financing Entity.
the bill of lading issued "to the order of" the Financing Entity.
the predefined order in which the Escrow Bank distributes funds received in the Escrow Account.
AgroTrust's proprietary framework for structured trade finance, combining warehouse collateral, Pledge Bonds, lender-controlled bills of lading, escrow accounts and a Payment Waterfall.
a structured trade finance operation carried out using the AgroTrust Structure.
the fee AgroTrust charges for access to the Platform and its structuring and coordination services.

ourRole.title: 2.1 Our role.
ourRole.content: AgroTrust is a technology platform and transaction structuring company. We design the AgroTrust Structure and coordinate the independent Participants who carry out each Transaction. Our services are limited to the following:
items: Structuring: designing the framework of a Transaction, including how Inventory is held as collateral, how title documents are controlled, and how payments flow through an Escrow Account and Payment Waterfall.
Coordination: coordinating timelines, documents and communications among Exporters, Financing Entities, Offtakers and Service Providers so each can perform its own role.
Documentation: preparing and circulating standard-form Transaction Documents and checklists for the Participants to review, negotiate with their own advisers, and sign.
Platform access: giving Participants access to the Platform, its tools, and a network of independent Service Providers that have agreed to operate within the AgroTrust Structure.
Operational support: following up on documents, booking and shipment milestones, and escrow instructions, and relaying information between Participants.

transactionWorks.title: 2.2 How a Transaction works.
items: The Exporter delivers Inventory to an independent collateral management warehouse, which inspects it and issues a Pledge Bond in favor of the Financing Entity.
The Financing Entity independently decides whether to lend, and signs a Loan Agreement directly with the Exporter.
The Inventory ships under a Master Bill of Lading issued "to the order of" the Financing Entity. Carriers, destination agents and customs brokers acknowledge the Financing Entity's control.
The Offtaker pays the full invoice into the Escrow Account held by an independent Escrow Bank.

The Escrow Bank distributes the funds under the Payment Waterfall set out in the Escrow Agreement: typically first to the Financing Entity (principal and interest), then to AgroTrust (Structuring Fee), then the balance to the Exporter.

proprietaryStructure.title: 2.3 Proprietary structure.
proprietaryStructure.content: The AgroTrust Structure, our documents, processes, pricing model, and partner arrangements are our confidential and proprietary information. Participants who sign a platform agreement may be bound by exclusivity and non-circumvention obligations set out in that agreement.

communications.title: 2.4 Communications.
communications.content: Where a Transaction Document requires it, electronic communications about Inventory, release instructions or escrow disbursements must copy all relevant parties and the designated AgroTrust address. AgroTrust relays and records these communications but does not authorize releases of Inventory or funds; only the party with that right under the Transaction Documents can do so.

noSolicitation.title: 3.1 No solicitation of investors or offering of securities.
noSolicitation.content: AgroTrust does not solicit, offer, sell, recommend or advertise investments, loans, notes, participations or any other financial product to any person. Nothing on the Platform is an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any security or investment. AgroTrust does not raise capital for Exporters or for itself through the Platform, and does not pool, manage or invest money on behalf of others.

notALender.title: 3.2 Not a lender or financial institution.
items: a lender, creditor or provider of financing;
a bank, trust company, credit institution or money services business;
a money transmitter, payment institution, exchange or currency dealer;
a broker, dealer, placement agent, finder or investment adviser;
an escrow agent, custodian, trustee or holder of client funds or digital assets;
an insurer or guarantor;
a warehouse operator, collateral manager, carrier, freight forwarder, NVOCC, customs broker or logistics provider;
a buyer or seller of any Inventory.

noHandlingOfFunds.title: 3.3 No handling of funds.
noHandlingOfFunds.content: AgroTrust never receives, holds, controls or disburses Transaction funds or Participant money. All Offtaker payments go to the Escrow Account held by an independent, regulated Escrow Bank, which alone executes the Payment Waterfall. AgroTrust receives only its own Structuring Fee, paid by the Escrow Bank under the Escrow Agreement. Any fiat-to-digital-asset conversion is carried out by independent, licensed providers under their own terms, not by AgroTrust.

noCreditDecisions.title: 3.4 No credit decisions, negotiation or advice.
noCreditDecisions.content: All decisions to lend, underwrite, approve, price or enforce financing are made solely by the Financing Entity and the Exporter. AgroTrust does not negotiate commercial or financial terms between Participants, does not act as agent for any Participant, and does not give financial, investment, legal, tax, accounting, customs or regulatory advice. Each Participant must rely on its own advisers.

noGuarantee.title: 3.5 No guarantee.
noGuarantee.content: AgroTrust does not guarantee and is not responsible for:
items: the availability of financing from any Financing Entity;
repayment of any loan, or the creditworthiness of any Participant;
payment by any Offtaker;
the quantity, quality, condition, existence, title or value of any Inventory;
the performance of any warehouse, escrow bank, carrier, agent, broker or other Service Provider;
the validity, enforceability or perfection of any security interest, Pledge Bond or bill of lading;
any return, yield or outcome of any Transaction.

noFiduciary.title: 3.6 No fiduciary relationship.
noFiduciary.content: AgroTrust is not a fiduciary, trustee, partner, joint venturer or agent of any Participant. Each Participant acts as an independent party for its own account and risk.

noDutyToMonitor.title: 3.7 No duty to monitor.
noDutyToMonitor.content: AgroTrust has no duty to monitor Transactions, investigate Participants, verify documents for authenticity, or ensure any Participant's legal or regulatory compliance.

independentParties.title: 4.1 Independent parties.
independentParties.content: Each Participant is solely responsible for its own role, performance, licenses, permits, taxes and compliance, and for the accuracy of everything it provides. The table summarizes each role as set out in the Transaction Documents; the signed Transaction Documents control.

tableRows.responsibility: Delivering Inventory to the designated warehouse; title to and accuracy of Inventory and documents; export permits, phytosanitary and origin certificates; directing all Offtaker payments to the Escrow Account; insurance required by the Loan Agreement; repaying the loan; costs and delays caused by its own documentation or conduct.

Its own credit analysis, approval, pricing and funding; holding and enforcing its security over the Pledge Bond and Master Bill of Lading; issuing release or enforcement instructions; its own licensing and lending-law compliance.
Paying the full invoice only into the Escrow Account; complying with import rules; inspection and acceptance of goods under its sale contract.
Opening and maintaining the Escrow Account; holding funds without commingling; executing the Payment Waterfall without discretion; its own KYC/AML on account holders and payors.

Receiving, inspecting, storing and insuring the Inventory; issuing the Pledge Bond; releasing Inventory only on the Financing Entity's written authorization; liability for loss, damage or misappropriation in its custody.

Issuing the Master Bill of Lading to the order of the Financing Entity; refusing release, telex release or changes of consignee without the Financing Entity's consent; following Financing Entity instructions after a default.
Holding the cargo and refusing release, clearance or delivery without the Financing Entity's written authorization.

tableRows.participant: Payment and digital asset service providers
tableRows.responsibility: Onboarding, KYC/AML, conversion and settlement under their own licenses and terms, including the requirement that fiat and digital asset accounts be held in the same name.

useOfDesignatedProviders.title: 4.2 Use of designated providers.
useOfDesignatedProviders.content: To preserve the controls that protect all Participants, a Transaction may require use of Service Providers that have agreed to operate within the AgroTrust Structure. Designation of a Service Provider is not a recommendation, endorsement or guarantee of it. Each Participant should do its own due diligence on every counterpart and Service Provider.

accurateInformation.title: 4.3 Accurate information.
accurateInformation.content: You represent that all information and documents you provide through the Platform are true, complete, current and authentic, and that you have the right to provide them. AgroTrust may rely on them without verification.

noDeviation.title: 4.4 No deviation.
noDeviation.content: Participants must not act outside the agreed AgroTrust Structure in any way that affects control of funds or Inventory, including receiving Offtaker payments outside the Escrow Account or requesting bill of lading amendments without the Financing Entity's consent.

ownResponsibility.title: 5.1 Each Participant's own responsibility.
ownResponsibility.content: AgroTrust does not perform, and is not responsible for, know-your-customer (KYC), customer due diligence, anti-money laundering (AML), counter-terrorist financing, anti-bribery, export control or sanctions screening of any Participant or counterpart. Each Participant is solely responsible for:
items: conducting its own KYC, due diligence and sanctions screening on every counterpart it deals with;
verifying the identity, beneficial ownership, source of funds and source of wealth of its counterparts;
complying with all AML, sanctions, anti-corruption, export control, customs and tax laws that apply to it;
filing any reports it is required to file with any authority.

regulatedInstitutions.title: 5.2 Regulated institutions.
regulatedInstitutions.content: Where the law requires KYC and AML checks for a Transaction, they are performed by the regulated institutions involved, including the Escrow Bank, any payment or digital asset service provider, and the Financing Entity, under their own policies. AgroTrust does not review, approve, rely on or vouch for those checks, and their outcome is not a representation by AgroTrust.

documentsPassed.title: 5.3 Documents passed through the Platform.
documentsPassed.content: If AgroTrust forwards onboarding documents between a Participant and a regulated institution at a Participant's request, it does so only as a courier of information. Forwarding is not verification, screening or approval.

yourRepresentations.title: 5.4 Your representations.
yourRepresentations.content: You represent and warrant, on each day you use the Platform, that:
items: you, your owners, directors, officers and controllers are not on any sanctions list maintained by the United States (including OFAC), the United Nations, the European Union, the United Kingdom, or any other applicable authority, and are not owned or controlled by such a person;
no funds, Inventory or proceeds you use in a Transaction derive from unlawful activity, and none will be used to benefit a sanctioned person or for any unlawful purpose;
you will not use the Platform to evade sanctions, export controls or currency controls.

agroTrustRights.title: 5.5 AgroTrust's rights.
agroTrustRights.content: Although it has no duty to do so, AgroTrust may at any time ask for information, decline to coordinate, pause or stop any Transaction, or suspend access, if it believes in good faith that a Transaction or Participant may breach law or these Terms. AgroTrust is not liable for any loss caused by doing so, and may share information with authorities when required by law.

funds.title: 6. Funds, escrow, digital assets and fees

escrow.title: 6.1 Escrow.
escrow.content: All Transaction proceeds are paid into the Escrow Account and distributed by the Escrow Bank under the Escrow Agreement. The Escrow Bank acts only on the escrow instructions; AgroTrust cannot direct, release or redirect funds. Payment instructions are irrevocable once set and may only be changed as the Escrow Agreement allows.

bewareOfFraud.title: 6.2 Beware of payment fraud.
bewareOfFraud.content: AgroTrust will never ask you to pay money to AgroTrust or to any account other than the Escrow Account named in the signed Transaction Documents. Before sending any payment, confirm the account details by a separate, trusted channel. AgroTrust is not liable for payments sent to the wrong account, including because of fraudulent or altered instructions.

digitalAssets.title: 6.3 Digital assets and currency conversion.
digitalAssets.content: Where a Participant chooses to convert fiat currency into stablecoins or other digital assets, or to settle in them, the service is provided by independent, licensed third parties under their own terms, KYC and "same name" requirements. AgroTrust does not hold, exchange, transmit or custody digital assets or currency, and is not responsible for those providers, for price or exchange rate movements, for blockchain or network failures, or for any regulatory treatment of digital assets in any jurisdiction.

structuringFee.title: 6.4 Structuring Fee.
structuringFee.content: The Structuring Fee is compensation for access to the Platform and for AgroTrust's structuring and coordination services. It is set in the platform agreement with the Exporter. It may be calculated by reference to transaction size or complexity for pricing purposes only; it is not a commission, interest, placement or finder's fee, or payment for raising capital. Unless agreed otherwise in writing, it is earned when the Offtaker's funds are received in the Escrow Account and is paid only through the Payment Waterfall.

bundledFees.title: 6.5 Bundled fees and third-party compensation.
bundledFees.content: The Structuring Fee is a bundled fee and may include amounts AgroTrust pays to Service Providers, such as escrow, warehouse, logistics or foreign exchange costs. AgroTrust may also receive compensation from Service Providers, including a share of fees they charge for services such as currency or digital asset conversion. The fee owed by a Participant is the fee stated in its signed agreements.

taxes.title: 6.6 Taxes.
taxes.content: Each Participant is responsible for its own taxes, duties and withholding arising from any Transaction. Amounts owed to AgroTrust are payable without set-off or deduction, except where the law requires withholding.

data.title: 7. Data, confidentiality, intellectual property and communications

confidentialInformation.title: 7.1 Confidential information.
confidentialInformation.content: The AgroTrust Structure, Transaction Documents, pricing, fee composition, partner relationships and operational processes are AgroTrust's confidential information. You may use them only to take part in Transactions and may not disclose, copy, reverse-engineer or replicate them. AgroTrust will keep your non-public business information confidential and share it only with Participants and Service Providers who need it to carry out your Transaction, with our advisers, or as required by law.

intellectualProperty.title: 7.2 Intellectual property.
intellectualProperty.content: AgroTrust owns all rights in the Platform, the AgroTrust name and logo, the AgroTrust Structure, and our documents, templates and content. We grant you a limited, revocable, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use them only for your own Transactions while these Terms apply. You may not copy, modify, distribute, sell or create derivative works from them, or use our name or marks without written permission.

yourContent.title: 7.3 Your content.
yourContent.content: You keep ownership of the documents and data you provide. You grant AgroTrust a license to use, store, copy and share them as needed to provide the Platform and coordinate your Transactions, to comply with law, and to improve our services in aggregated or anonymized form.

privacy.title: 7.4 Privacy.
privacy.content: Our handling of personal information is described in our Privacy Policy, which forms part of these Terms.

electronicCommunications.title: 7.5 Electronic communications and signatures.
electronicCommunications.content: You agree to receive notices and documents electronically and to sign Transaction Documents by electronic signature (for example DocuSign). Electronic records and signatures have the same effect as originals.
